svg.title: A connector overhanging a breakaway edge
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan views with side views below. Left, marked wrong: boards A and B meet at a V-score line, and a coax connector on board A hangs 7 mm past it, over board B. In the side view, board B is bent up to snap the score and meets the underside of the connector, marked in red, before the score can break. Right, marked right: board A's edge is routed and held by two tabs with mouse bites, and a routed relief cut-out in the panel leaves 10 mm from board A's edge, so nothing is in the way. The connector's silkscreen outline includes the part past the edge.

g.text: Side view: board B bent to snap the score
✓ Routed edge with a relief cut-out
Connector hangs 7 mm past board A
About 10 mm from the edge for a 7 mm overhang
Edge routed and held by tabs
Mouse bites just inside the edge
Silkscreen outline of the whole part
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm. Values from PCB-DFA-010.
